te: Observations on the draft military courts law, and the idea of a veterans' family association
se: The meeting considered views and recommendations on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. ...., the idea of setting up a veterans' family association to promote careers and income, and the schedule of a study visit to the National Science and Technology Development Agency, and noted the committee's meeting on border security in Ranong and Chumphon
it: Views and recommendations on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. ....
The idea of setting up a veterans' family association
Schedule of the study visit to the National Science and Technology Development Agency

te: Action plan for fiscal year 2027 set, and a parliamentary TV programme on careers for veterans prepared
se: The meeting noted progress on the draft laws on military courts and on the organisation of the Ministry of Defence, considered the action plan for fiscal year 2027, and noted the committee's resolution to broadcast the programme "Mong Ratthasapha" on the electric taxi career development project for veterans on 27 July 2026
it: Action plan for fiscal year 2027
The programme "Mong Ratthasapha" on electric taxi careers for veterans

te: Consideration of the draft military courts law in the House of Representatives followed up
se: The meeting noted progress in the consideration of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers) by the ad hoc committee of the House of Representatives, and considered the work of the working groups
it: Progress in the consideration of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers)
Progress of 4 working groups (armed forces structure, reserve forces, veterans, law and special affairs)

te: The Ministry of Defence gives information on the draft military courts law, and the study visit to the East summarised
se: The meeting noted the status of budget spending and information from representatives of the Ministry of Defence on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers). It approved the appointment of 4 additional advisers, and noted the summary of the study visit on military affairs to Chachoengsao, Chanthaburi, Rayong and Chon Buri on 17–19 June 2026
it: Information on the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers)
Appointment of advisers to the subcommittee
Summary of the study visit to the East, 17–19 June 2026

te: Draft laws on military courts and on the organisation of the Ministry of Defence taken up for study
se: The meeting noted work referred by the committee: the study of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers), which the House of Representatives has accepted in principle; the matter of encroachment on state land and natural resources in the area of the 4th Army Area; and the setting up of a working group on concrete bunkers to protect personnel and people along the border. It also noted the work of the working groups, such as farmland for veterans
it: Study of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers)
Working group set up to consider strengthening safety along the border, in the matter of concrete bunkers
Progress of 4 working groups (armed forces structure, reserve forces, veterans, law and special affairs)

te: Committee approves the report on veterans' benefits, and assigns a study of life insurance for soldiers
se: The meeting noted that the committee had approved the draft study report on developing criteria for veterans' benefits and had assigned the subcommittee to study life insurance premiums for soldiers serving in field or border operations in the area of the 2th Army Area. It also considered the schedule of a study visit to the East on 17–19 June 2026
it: Draft study report: developing criteria for veterans' benefits
Study of life insurance premiums for soldiers serving in field operations, 2th Army Area
Schedule of study visits to Chachoengsao, Chanthaburi, Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces, 17–19 June 2026

te: A new First Vice-Chair, and study reports to be completed by June
se: The meeting noted the changes of positions in the committee and the subcommittee, the appointment of Miss Nuannit Hongviwatana as First Vice-Chair of the subcommittee, and the committee's framework asking for reports to be completed by June 2026. It also noted the summary of site visits to Roi Et, Maha Sarakham and Khon Kaen, and the report on the forum "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace"
it: Appointment of the First Vice-Chair of the subcommittee, and the committee's work framework
Summary of site visits to Roi Et, Maha Sarakham and Khon Kaen Provinces, 7–9 May 2026
Report on the forum "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace"

te: Special lecture on French military courts and a study visit to the East prepared
se: The meeting proposed to the committee that the subcommittee attend a special lecture on the military courts of the French Republic at the Judge Advocate General's Department on 14 May 2026, requested a study visit on military and security affairs to Chachoengsao, Chanthaburi, Rayong and Chon Buri, and noted progress on the forum "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace"
it: Attending the special lecture on the military courts of the French Republic
Study visit on military and security affairs in the East
Progress of 4 working groups (armed forces structure, reserve forces, veterans, law and special affairs)

te: Election of the new committee chair noted, and personnel allowances followed up
se: The meeting noted the work of the working groups, an approach to the Permanent Secretary for Defence's reply letter on rewards for personnel serving on the Thai–Cambodian border, and the outcome of the committee's meeting on 22 April 2026, which elected its chair, vice-chairs and other officers and set a new work framework
it: Follow-up matters from the subcommittee and the committee

te: Forum on the southern border prepared, and a special working group on personnel allowances set up
se: The meeting proposed to the committee that the First Vice-President of the Senate be invited to preside at the opening of the forum "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace" at King Prajadhipok's Institute, approved a draft order setting up a special working group on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations, and proposed an approach to the Permanent Secretary for Defence's reply letter. It also noted a subcommittee member's report following the international situation
it: Forum "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace", 20 May 2026
Appointment of a special working group on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations

te: Working group's study report on developing conscripts considered
se: The meeting noted the outcome of hearing Ministry of Defence agencies at the previous meeting, and considered study reports of the working groups, such as on approaches to developing armed forces personnel, in the case of conscripts
it: Study report: approaches to developing armed forces personnel, in the case of conscripts
Progress of 4 working groups (armed forces structure, reserve forces, veterans, law and special affairs)

te: Defence agencies invited to give information on reserve forces, reserve officer training students and conscript training
se: The meeting approved the report on the forum "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade" and invited representatives of the Defence Mobilisation Department, the Territorial Defence Command, the Army Training Command, the personnel departments of the three armed services and the Armed Forces Development Command to give information on calling up reserve forces, the reserve officer training course, conscript training, and developing disaster relief instructors
it: Report on the forum "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade"
Calling up reserve forces, the reserve officer training course, and conscript training

te: The Defence Mobilisation Department gives information on amending the military service law
se: The meeting noted the forum project "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace" on 20 May 2026, and heard a representative of the Defence Mobilisation Department on improving the Military Service Act B.E. 2530 (1987). The draft amendment is being checked by the Judge Advocate General's Department before public consultation through the Central Law Portal
it: Academic forum project "22 Years of the Southern Border Provinces: Security Lessons Learned towards a Safe Area and Lasting Peace", 20 May 2026
Improving and amending the Military Service Act B.E. 2530 (1987)

te: Forum on the southern border situation prepared, and a study visit to a disaster management training institute
se: The meeting noted the draft project for an academic forum on the situation in the southern border provinces, prepared a study visit on training courses at the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Academy, Pathum Thani Province, on 26 March 2026, and noted progress on study reports on developing conscripts and on using reserve forces to support disaster relief
it: Draft project for an academic forum on the situation in the southern border provinces
Study visit to the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Academy, Pathum Thani Province, 26 March 2026
Progress of study reports on conscripts, and on reserve forces and disaster relief

te: Results of the fact-finding on flooding in Sukhothai noted, and matters from the committee followed up
se: The meeting noted follow-up matters from the committee, such as the results of fact-finding on a petition from 12 people concerning standing floodwater in Thani Subdistrict, Mueang Sukhothai District, proposals on special rewards for personnel, a Cabinet resolution on the Thailand–Indonesia high-level committee, and matters from the Senators Meet the People project
it: Results of fact-finding on a petition concerning standing floodwater, Sukhothai Province
Other follow-up matters from the committee (rewards for personnel, Thailand–Indonesia cooperation)

te: The Prime Minister asks the Ministry of Defence to consider rewards for personnel, and a veterans forum on 17 February prepared
se: The meeting noted that, following the committee's proposal that the government consider special rewards for personnel who served in combat on the Thai–Cambodian border in July–December 2025, the Prime Minister has assigned the Ministry of Defence to consider the matter and report back. It noted the preparations for the forum "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade" on 17 February 2026, and considered the study visit plan and the working groups' reports
it: Outcome of the letter to the government on special rewards for personnel
Preparations for the forum "Veterans: From the Battlefield to New Careers of the Decade", 17 February 2026
Study visit plan and working group reports
